issues.what:
Aspect 'no-marker' is refused on node:feature by a deterministic check.
Violations:
other.mjs:1: unfinished-work marker left behind.
issues.why: A deterministic check recorded these violations. The result is cached — the same inputs reproduce the same verdict, so the check is not re-run.
issues.next: Fix the listed violations, then: yg check --approve
issues.label: enforced

issues.what: Judgment aspect 'plain-names' on node:feature has no reviewer to judge it.
issues.why: yg-config.yaml has no reviewer: section, so nothing can read this content.md rule. Re-running --approve cannot change that; it stays unverified until a reviewer is configured or the rule is set to status: draft.
issues.next: yg init --provider <name> [--model <m>] — the user's decision, since it sends code to that provider — or set the judgment aspect to status: draft
issues.label: reviewer-missing

issues.what: A judgment rule has no judge: yg-config.yaml has no reviewer: section.
issues.why: Script rules run locally for free (yg check --approve --only-deterministic still fills them), but a judgment rule (content.md) needs a configured model to read it — until then its pairs stay unverified. Configuring a reviewer is the user's decision: it sends code to that provider, on their account.
issues.next: yg init --provider <name> [--model <m>] (an installed agent CLI — claude-code, codex, gemini-cli, copilot-cli — needs no API key), or set the judgment rule to status: draft until a reviewer is chosen.
issues.label: config-reviewer-missing

issues.what: Node type 'module' is not defined — yg-architecture.yaml declares no node types yet.
issues.why: While node_types is empty, node types are not checked. Once any type is declared, every node whose type is missing becomes a blocking type-undefined error, and a type whose nodes map files must declare when:.
issues.next: Define 'module' under node_types in yg-architecture.yaml with a when: predicate matching its files (an architecture change — confirm it first). yg type-suggest --file <path> can help design it.
issues.label: type-undefined-pending

issues.what:
1 coverage-visible file outside any required coverage root.
  package.json
issues.why: Not under a coverage.required root — visible but non-blocking. Bring an area under graph coverage to enforce it. Your architecture has no type for this file yet.
issues.next: Map these files to a node, or add their root to coverage.required to make this an error. Or design an architecture type that covers files like it: yg type-suggest --file <path>.
issues.label: uncovered
